limits: Finite declared lot grid only, not a global or dynamic optimum.
Observed fills, forecast calibration, future liquidity and corporate account reconciliation are not established.
No integration into the six measured historical recipes; no economic superiority claim.
reviewed_contracts: Forecast decision/model/label clocks and15s/168h configuration maxima cannot be extended.

Purchases and fees are funded from pre-sale available cash, excluding receivables.
